location_qualifier: representative point for the start of the escape; the end place is not named
current_activity: The remnants of the 6th SS Mountain Division, with Brenner, are rounded up on 2 April after three days east of Limburg
notes: Event date: CMH The Last Offensive ch. 16 p. 350: "Brenner and his force would begin an attempt to infiltrate back to German lines, an odyssey destined to end three days later, on 2 April, when the remnants, including General Brenner, were finally rounded up"; CMH The Last Offensive ch. 17 p. 378: "During the last day of March and the first two of April, General Brenner and the survivors of his 6th SS Mountain Division, bypassed in the swift American drive, tried to fight their way out to the east". Event definition: the rounding up of the remnants on 2 April. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Limburg an der Lahn, Hessen with a precision of 50 km. Location approximate: a representative point at Limburg an der Lahn for a trail that began west of the autobahn near Limburg and ran east; the end place is not named. Location support: CMH puts the division, about 2,000 men, west of the Limburg autobahn on 28-30 March and says it then tried to infiltrate east; it names no place for 2 April. Commander: General Brenner (as named by CMH). Opponents: US 9th Armored Division, VIII Corps.
